summary: Completed backend API regression and frontend UI/integration validation for the new Project Information scope. All requested in-scope flows passed, including nav/anchors, responsive checks, stats fallback behavior, and citizen report create/get/advance persistence.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical code-level defects found in the tested scope.
Mock/demo labeling is consistently present for alerts, conditions, workflow reasoning, and photos (MOCKED/SIMULATED behavior is disclosed).
seed_data_creation: Created automated test citizen reports in public DB during UI/API regression: ORC-9F8E, ORC-37C8, ORC-E9F4, ORC-E153.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL from frontend/.env was used. Backend pytest passed (6/6). Frontend checks validated: project-information section content/anchors/source rows, hero claim corrections, blocked /api/stats fallback to dash+unavailable, responsive widths 320/768/1024/1440 no horizontal overflow, mobile nav open-close and keyboard interactions, and report persistence + manual advance via UI and GET/PATCH APIs.
rca of the issue: One intermediate UI run showed non-persistent advance and missing toast text due test timing/selector strategy; reproduced and resolved in follow-up runs. Root cause was test-method flakiness (insufficient wait/lookup strategy), not product behavior.
